metadata.benchmark_phase: Phase 6b — Comprehensive Platform Security Wire Battery

test_results.details: RBAC Matrix FAILED: 3 server errors encountered (expected zero). Three 500s documented under DEFECT-API-02 (missing ProjectMember.user eager load on GET /projects/{id} returning 500 for lead, tester, viewer). Expected-Allow: 215 (2xx: 88, 404/422: 124, 5xx: 3). Expected-Deny: 165 (blocked 401/403/404: 127).
100% IDOR boundary enforcement verified. Owner Controls: 10/10 returned 200/201. Cross-Tenant Probes: 20/20 blocked with HTTP 403/404. Zero 5xx errors.
Canary sensor actively targeted over wire (9 probes rejected); 0 canary hits verified; temporary bench attach/detach proved.
Documented Gap (DEFECT-AUTH-03 / P2): POST /api/v1/auth/login lacks rate limiting. Token lifetime (60m) and uniform error responses verified.
Mass assignment strictly blocked (403); zero 500 errors across 5 fuzzed endpoints; input validation robust.
API tamper blocked (404/405); DB role UPDATE rolled back cleanly (0 persisted); live audit chain valid (1326 entries).
All 5 prod containers unprivileged; zero docker.sock mounts; DB and Redis isolated without host port publish.
HTML report generated safely; markup escaped; directory traversal download blocked.
npm audit completed (2 total vulns: critical=1, high=1); pip-audit and container image scanners Not Tested (binaries not installed, installs prohibited per test rules).
10/10 adversarial prompt injection vectors withstood by live Azure GPT-5.6 gateway (azure/gpt-5.6-terra-dev-gtw) (0 overrides, 0 unauthorized dispatches). Total Tokens: 1471.
